column5: TwasWeights S4 (enet, --seed 1) from twas_weights.R on qtl_mini; glmnet-cv reproducible under the seed. x86/ARM CI may need a looser rtol. The collection therefore carries a `region` mcols column and the per-row grange_start/grange_end are populated (previously NA on every path, because no caller passed `region` to postprocessFinemappingFits). Verified the ONLY change: with the `region` column and grange_* dropped, old vs new are all.equal at 1e-6. TwasWeights carries the same `region` provenance column as the fine-mapping collections.
